name: IMO-AnswerBench
intro: IMO-AnswerBench 是 IMO-Bench 论文套件中的可验证简答基准，包含 400 道手工筛选的奥林匹克数学题，代数、组合、几何和数论各 100 道。题目经改写与稳健化以得到唯一、清晰且非平凡的短答案，并由奖牌得主和数学家复核；Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader 提取最终答案并判断与标准答案的语义等价性。
build_method: 专家筛选奥赛题、改写稳健化、奖牌得主复核
eval_feature: 语义等价答案评分、多次运行
scale: 400 道题；四个类别各 100 道
build_method_en: Expert Olympiad selection, reformulation and robustification, and medalist review
eval_feature_en: Semantic-equivalence answer grading and repeated runs
intro_en: IMO-AnswerBench is the verifiable short-answer component of the IMO-Bench paper suite. It contains 400 handpicked Olympiad mathematics problems, with 100 each in algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory. Problems are reformulated and robustified to have unique, clear, non-trivial short answers and are vetted by medalists and mathematicians. A Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader extracts the final answer and judges semantic equivalence to the reference.
scale_en: 400 problems; 100 in each of four categories

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2511.01846v1, the paper release at google-deepmind/superhuman commit 92ae8c2e88dee12a3f793dd88a5e80ed76754c2a, and current project snapshot 96fa6c4cc3a9bb7450ee7b6773b659d3a030dace. The paper handpicks 400 national, regional, and international Olympiad problems: exactly 100 each in algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory. The pre-IMO / IMO-Easy / IMO-Medium / IMO-Hard breakdown is Algebra 11/46/32/11, Combinatorics 4/19/31/46, Geometry 13/44/32/11, and Number Theory 2/20/31/47. Proof-heavy problems are reformulated to produce unique, clear, non-trivial short answers, then robustified by paraphrasing, renaming objects, changing values, or adding distractors. A panel collectively holding 10 IMO gold and 5 silver medals vets the content. Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader judges only final-answer semantic equivalence and returns boxed Correct or Incorrect. Its 800-item human audit has cells 274/1/8/517, for 791 agreements. Paper results report overall and category accuracy, usually averaged over eight runs. Commit ea72dda6e4aa615d940cf84713b142bcb0aa75b5 added answerbench_v2.csv, and 955558ad67ef24dccd27545c326988bdad1b4471 applied the follow-up answer fix; v2 retains 400 rows and records the 2026-02-12 ambiguity/answer correction. The repository publishes CSV data but no executable AnswerAutoGrader or output parser.
